retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast 1980s glamour aesthetic featuring a profile subject with sensory props against a vibrant, airbrushed solid color field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A profile-view portrait of a woman wearing bulky vintage headphones while holding an ice cream cone, set against a vibrant, slightly vignetted red background with sharp, aggressive geometric typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject profile oriented diagonally from bottom-right to center-left
Ice cream cone positioned as a vertical counter-balance to the head's tilt
Typography centered at the top, overlapping the background and subject's hair
High-gloss textures on nails and headphones contrasting with soft skin tones
coreInvariants: Saturated red background with subtle central glow
Sharp, angular custom lettering with heavy outlines

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame in a tight profile crop.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, olive-green headphone ear cup acts as the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes follow the upward tilt of the chin to the ice cream, then to the sharp logo at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Concentrated in the upper left and right corners to allow the logo to breathe.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Vibrant crimson red background providing high energy.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Olive green and cool white (ice cream) to break the warm dominance.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep pink/magenta on nails and lips.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with deep shadows in the hair and headphone crevices.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy black outlines with thin white inner strokes
Exaggerated horizontal bars on letters like 'F' and 'L'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'V' and 'A' are mirrored sharp wedges
The 'L' has an elongated base that underlines subsequent letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive, heavy custom display type paired with a clean, widely-spaced minimalist sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thick black keyline around the main title

preserve: Wide letter spacing for the subtitle

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the aggressive, sharp geometric terminals of the main title.
Appropriate for the clean, spaced-out subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio photograph of a woman in profile, head tilted back, wearing large olive-green vintage headphones and holding a melting vanilla ice cream cone with a cherry on top. The background is a solid, vibrant red with a soft central spotlight effect.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, sharp, geometric custom logo in the top center with white fill and thick black outlines. Below it, add a secondary line of text in a thin, widely-spaced white sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the background a saturated red?
Are the headphones bulky and industrial in style?
Is the main title text sharp and angular?
Is the ice cream cone held vertically near the mouth?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the model
postGenerationChecks: Check that the typography does not obscure the main facial features.
Ensure the red background has a subtle gradient/vignette rather than being a flat hex fill.
Verify the ice cream texture looks realistic and creamy.
Confirm the headphones look like 1970s/80s hardware.
recipe.reuseFormula: Retro Glamour Portrait + Industrial Prop + Saturated Color Field + Aggressive Geometric Type
